page.overview:
Who is Kallie Calwell?

Kallie Calwell, was the daughter of Dannar and Annileen Calwell, two Human Merchants of the Pika Oasis. She was also the sister of Jabe Calwell.

At the age of nine Kallie was entrusted to take care of the Calwell family dewbacks.

In 19 BBY Kallie was still working with her family's dewbacks. While on a dewback named Snit the animal stampeded and headed towards the Rumbles which contained one of Tatooine's sarlaccs. Her mother Annileen attempted a rescue. This was when Obi-Wan Kenobi appeared to help the teenager before they fell into the pit of the sarlacc.

Kenobi saved Kallie and Annileen but the dewback Snit was killed by the sarlacc. Annileen who had been knocked out when Kenobi threw her off the back of the dewback with the Force and told Kallie that the money to replace the dewback would come out of her wages.
